subject: The one mistake 90% of students make with thesis statements
preview_text: It's not what you think. And it's costing you hours of rewriting. Here's the 60-second fix.
body_paragraphs: I was watching a student use the app yesterday. They typed their topic, hit generate, and got a decent thesis. Then they spent 45 minutes trying to make it 'perfect' before writing a single paragraph. That's the mistake. The secret isn't a perfect thesis. It's a good enough thesis that gets you writing.

Here's the tiny trick: Generate your thesis, then immediately start your outline. Don't edit the thesis yet. Write three supporting points based on what you've got. The magic happens when you're already moving. Your brain starts solving problems you couldn't see while staring at that blinking cursor. The thesis will evolve naturally as you write—that's how real papers get built.

Thesis Generator's 'Outline Builder' feature is designed for this exact flow. It takes your generated thesis and instantly creates a skeleton. You're not starting from a blank page anymore. You're starting from momentum. That 10-minute thesis just bought you 3 hours of productive writing time.

Open the app right now. Pick your last thesis draft and hit 'Build Outline.' Don't perfect the thesis first. Just start. See how much further you get in 20 minutes than you normally would in 2 hours. P.S. The students who do this trick average 30% faster paper completion. They're not smarter. They just stopped editing before they started.
